project: OpenIslet.org (Project Islet-1) — Executable Public Idea Graveyard & Negative-Evidence Rule Engine
purpose: Prevent duplicate wet-lab failures and computational confirmation bias by permanently indexing falsified hypotheses, epistatic promoter-pathway deadlocks, safety-switch escape traps, and physiological trade-offs with machine-executable trigger rules.

severity_level_semantics.BLOCK: Hard feasibility veto: sets is_feasible_candidate = false and composite_series_system_utility = 0.0 (while retaining unblocked_diagnostic_utility for sensitivity auditing).
severity_level_semantics.WARN: Quantitative logit penalty and/or mandatory pre-specified wet-lab falsification gate (does NOT set is_feasible_candidate = false). For example, GRAVEYARD_009 and GRAVEYARD_010 trigger on ALLO_B2M_HLAE_CD47_SWAP_CIITA_KO (Chassis A) to require the lineage-specific Hour-0 density and indirect-APC decision experiments. Gate 2B uses the declared -0.25 engineering-prior logit discount; the former 0.84 ceiling description is not an implemented hard probability ceiling.

trigger_pattern.condition: (STAT1_KO_or_JAK1_KO AND GAS_ISRE_promoter AND NOT NFkB_enhancer_bypass) OR (TYK2_KO AND strict_TypeI_IFN_ISRE_without_IFNg_or_NFkB_bypass)

graveyard_entries.proposed_idea: Combine clonal STAT1-/- or JAK1-/- knockout with an IFN-gamma/STAT1-inducible (GAS/ISRE) promoter driving PD-L1 and SERPINB9 (or combine TYK2-/- with a strict Type-I-IFN ISRE-only promoter).
graveyard_entries.why_it_fails: Mechanistic epistatic pathway synthesis across component SC-islet studies (not a single combined wet-lab construct test): deleting STAT1 or JAK1 (or upstream IFNGR1 / IRF1) blocks canonical IFN-gamma -> IFNGR1 -> JAK1/JAK2 -> STAT1/IRF1 phosphorylation and nuclear translocation (Sintov et al. 2022 PMID:36055241 demonstrated that clonal STAT1-/- ST1L SC-islets lose IFN-gamma-inducible PD-L1, HLA-E, and SOCS1 upregulation and suffer increased NK cell apoptosis, whereas Chandra et al. 2022 PMID:36289205 demonstrated that TYK2-/- blocks Type I IFN-alpha/beta -> TYK2/JAK1 -> STAT1/STAT2/ISGF3 signaling). Consequently, pairing STAT1/JAK1/IFNGR1/IRF1 KO with a pure STAT1-dependent GAS/ISRE synthetic promoter creates an epistatic deadlock unless driven by an endogenous locus such as CXCL10 (Sintov et al. 2022 PMID:36055241; Tanaka et al. 2009 PMID:19641142) that retains an independent TNF-alpha/IL-1beta -> NF-kB enhancer bypass (which likewise precludes co-deleting TNFRSF1A alongside IL1R1 on CXCL10-driven Islet-1 constructs; IIP-0018). Note on single-receptor TNFRSF1A knockdown (IIP-0022; DEC-101): unlike combined TNFRSF1A + IL1R1 removal, TNFRSF1A knockdown alone leaves IL1R1 and IFN-gamma inputs intact (attenuating TNF-alpha NF-kB drive rather than causing total promoter deadlock), so any Locus-3 TNFRSF1A proposal requires empirical CXCL10 and Syn_3xISRE_2xNFkB induction and basal-floor verification alongside single-AAV6 <= 4,700 bp packaging checks.
graveyard_entries.cheapest_falsification_assay: 24h IFN-gamma + TNF-alpha + IL-1beta stimulation of STAT1-/- vs WT SC-islets measuring surface PD-L1 molecules/cell by calibrated flow cytometry.
graveyard_entries.Evaluator_Penalty_Rule: Hard BLOCK (composite_series_system_utility = 0.0, is_feasible_candidate = false) + unblocked diagnostic logit penalties (-0.85 on Gate 2B, -1.35 on Gate 4) when STAT1/JAK1 KO is paired with GAS/ISRE inducible promoter without NF-kB bypass.

trigger_pattern.condition: iCasp9 driven by mature beta-cell restricted promoter (G6PC2 or INS) rather than pan-lineage safe-harbor promoter

graveyard_entries.proposed_idea: Place the inducible Caspase-9 (iCasp9) prodrug suicide switch under the endogenous G6PC2 or INS promoter so that a single edit simultaneously deletes an autoantigen and installs a safety switch.
graveyard_entries.why_it_fails: G6PC2 and INS promoters are active only in mature differentiated beta-cells. Any residual undifferentiated iPSC, proliferating neural/mesodermal teratoma cell, off-target SLC18A1+ enterochromaffin cell, or cytokine-dedifferentiated beta-cell shuts off G6PC2/INS transcription and becomes 100% resistant to AP1903/rimiducid ablation. Furthermore, monoallelic safe-harbor iCasp9 insertion suffers epigenetic silencing or LOH at 10^-6 to 10^-5 frequency.
graveyard_entries.cheapest_falsification_assay: Clonogenic escape assay spiking 10% undifferentiated iPSCs + Stage 7 SC-islets under 10 nM AP1903 dimerizer for 72h (target upper confidence bound <10^-8 surviving proliferating cells).
graveyard_entries.replacement_solution: Use biallelic housekeeping/safe-harbor knock-in (biallelic AAVS1-CAG-iCasp9 or GAPDH-P2A-iCasp9; Wunderlich et al. 2022 PMID:35795779; Gerace et al. 2023 PMID:36599351) and verify <10^-8 escape frequency across undifferentiated and endocrine lineages.

trigger_pattern.condition: Biallelic G6PC2-/- knockout included without dynamic perifusion 2.8 mM shutoff validation

graveyard_entries.proposed_idea: Include biallelic G6PC2 (IGRP) knockout in every universal allogeneic beta-cell chassis to eliminate the IGRP 265-273 CD8+ T-cell autoantigen and boost glycolytic flux.
graveyard_entries.why_it_fails: G6PC2 catalyzes glucose-6-phosphate hydrolysis in the beta-cell glucokinase/G6PC2 futile substrate cycle, which sets the threshold for shutting off insulin secretion when blood glucose falls below 4.0 mM. Bosma et al. 2020 (PMID:32569842) report a modest (~12%) reduction in fasting blood glucose in G6pc2-/- mice and Overway et al. 2022 (PMID:34954144) identify human G6PC2 coding variants that reduce G6PC2 protein expression and lower fasting glucose; although neither paper demonstrates severe clinical hypoglycemia in human SC-islet grafts, shifting the glucose set-point downward creates a precautionary counter-regulatory hazard if unvalidated in dynamic perifusion.
graveyard_entries.cheapest_falsification_assay: Dynamic perifusion step-down (16.7 mM -> 2.8 mM glucose) measuring time-to-50%-and-90% insulin shutoff (<3 min required) and basal insulin leak at 2.8 mM.
graveyard_entries.replacement_solution: Remove G6PC2-/- from the default Universal Chassis A core; require dynamic perifusion 11 mM -> 2.8 mM glucose shut-off validation before using G6PC2 edits.

trigger_pattern.condition: RNLS-/- included without Stage 7 metabolic maturation and <=120 um cluster diameter control

graveyard_entries.proposed_idea: Assume biallelic RNLS (Renalase) knockout is a zero-cost survival boost across all human SC-islet protocols based on mouse NIT-1 CRISPR screen results (Cai et al. 2020 PMID:32719542).
graveyard_entries.why_it_fails: While RNLS-/- protects mouse NIT-1 beta-cells (Cai et al. 2020 PMID:32719542) and increases glycolytic flux (ECAR) and mitochondrial respiration (OCR) in 3D aggregated human iPSC-derived SC-islets, MacDonald et al. 2025 (PMID:39988068, Fig. 6) report that poor glucose responsiveness and absent acute GSIS persisted in both WT and RNLS KO Stage 6 human SC-beta cells and that elevated basal OCR + ECAR increases metabolic oxygen demand unless paired with Stage 7 maturation and <=120 um cluster diameter control.
graveyard_entries.cheapest_falsification_assay: Isogenic WT vs RNLS-/- Stage 7 SC-islet dynamic perifusion GSIS + Seahorse basal/stimulated OCR at 120 um vs 200 um cluster diameter.
graveyard_entries.replacement_solution: Exclude RNLS-/- from the lean 4-locus Universal Chassis A core; evaluate head-to-head in Stage 7 Balboa-matured <=120 um clusters.

trigger_pattern.condition: HLA-A-/-, HLA-B-/-, CIITA-/- retaining a single HLA-C allele without verifying whether endogenous HLA-C expression alone stabilizes sufficient surface HLA-E after HLA-A/HLA-B deletion

graveyard_entries.proposed_idea: Assume any HLA-A-/-, HLA-B-/-, CIITA-/- iPSC line retaining a single matched HLA-C allele automatically satisfies both KIR+ and NKG2A+ human NK cells without needing empirical HLA-E stabilization checks.
graveyard_entries.why_it_fails: Mechanistic synthesis combining human HLA/NK immunogenetics with HLA-edited hPSC/SC-islet studies: in classical human HLA class I genetics, the leader-peptide position -21 methionine (-21M) vs threonine (-21T) dimorphism is an HLA-B polymorphism (Ramsuran et al. 2018 Science PMID:29302013), and HLA-C is expressed at ~10-fold lower basal surface density than HLA-A/HLA-B on resting parenchymal cells (Xu et al. 2019 PMID:30853558; Parent et al. 2021 PMID:34407395). Crucially, Lin et al. 2023 Nature Immunology (PMID:37264229, PMC10690437, DOI:10.1038/s41590-023-01523-z, Table 1 & Supplementary Table 1) demonstrate that among 16 common classical HLA class I signal peptide (SP) variants only 6 are functional VL9 donors for CD94/NKG2A recognition, stratifying HLA-C signal peptides into functional HLA-E binders SP-1C (MRVMAPRTLILLLSGALALTETWA, nonamer VMAPRTLIL, P6=Thr, P8=Ile: HLA-C*01:02, C*03:04, C*04:01, C*05:01, C*06:02, C*08:01, C*12:02, C*14:02, C*16:01; 65.17% of 1000G alleles; Lin et al. 2023 PMID:37264229 Supplementary Table 1 soluble HLA-E*01:03 SPR K_D = 1.33 uM [95% CI 1.15-1.53] for CD94/NKG2A and 4.35 uM [4.24-4.46] for CD94/NKG2C; Vales-Gomez et al. 1999 PMID:10428963 Table I CD94/NKG2A K_D = 7.35 uM for VMAPRTLIL [indexed there under HLA-Cw*0302, whereas rare allele HLA-Cw*0402 / C*04:02 carries the P3-Glu substitution VMEPRTLIL with K_D >= 75.30 uM, distinct from common HLA-C*04:01 SP-1C VMAPRTLIL]) and SP-2C (MRVMAPRTLLLLLSGALALTETWA, nonamer VMAPRTLLL, P6=Thr, P8=Leu: C*02:02, C*15:02, C*15:05; 8.58% 1000G C*02:02+C*15:02 aggregate; Lin et al. 2023 PMID:37264229 Supplementary Table 1 direct soluble HLA-E*01:03 SPR K_D = 1.70 uM [95% CI 1.50-1.93] for CD94/NKG2A and 4.97 uM [4.80-5.14] for CD94/NKG2C; unmeasured in Vales-Gomez 1999; note VMAPRTLVL is the HLA-A*02:01 SP-2A nonamer), versus non-functional SP-3C (MRVMAPRALLLLLSGGLALTETWA, nonamer VMAPRALLL, carrying the position -16 / P6=Ala [T6A, with P5=Arg] substitution in HLA-C*07:01, C*07:02, and C*07:04; 24.49% of 1000G alleles; UniProt P10321) and SP-4C (VMAPQALLL in C*17:01; 1.76%), for which exogenous synthetic peptide pulsing can stabilize surface HLA-E (Lin et al. 2023 Fig. 1a), whereas natural signal-peptide processing yields substantially weaker surface HLA-E expression (Lin et al. 2023 Fig. 1c) and the P6-Ala substitution fails to functionally engage CD94/NKG2A to inhibit NKG2A+ NK cell lysis (Lin et al. 2023 Fig. 1-2). Therefore, deleting HLA-A and HLA-B while retaining an SP-3C allele such as HLA-C*07:02 without an exogenous HLA-E SCT cloak leaves NKG2A+ KIR2DL- NK cells uninhibited (whereas pairing with AAVS1 HLA-E SCT in Design B-prime or selecting SP-1C C*03:04/C*04:01 restores HLA-E; evaluator_logit_delta = 0.0 for the cloaked/SP-1C-gated slot, with counterfactual GRAVEYARD_010 Gate-2B indirect-APC delta = -0.25 and counterfactual uncloaked SP-3C Gate-3 delta = -0.15 reducing Chassis B composite index from 0.0673 -> 0.0623 -> 0.0589 and pediatric index from 0.0664 -> 0.0612 -> 0.0579 [or to 0.0577 composite and 0.0567 pediatric under a harsher -0.20 Gate-3 logit shift]; Q2-P2). Furthermore, co-targeting HLA-A (chr6:29.94 Mb) and HLA-B (chr6:31.35 Mb) in cis on chromosome 6p21.3 carries a ~1.41 Mb megabase interstitial deletion / LOH risk spanning the intervening MHC class I interval along physical order HLA-A (chr6:29.94 Mb) -> HLA-E (chr6:30.49 Mb) -> HLA-C (chr6:31.27 Mb) -> HLA-B (chr6:31.35 Mb) if cut simultaneously, requiring sequential editing or long-read/ddPCR copy-number verification that both HLA-E and the retained HLA-C allele remain intact.
graveyard_entries.cheapest_falsification_assay: Primary human NK killing assay across CMV-seropositive (NKG2C-high) and CMV-seronegative (NKG2A-high, KIR-typed) donors against resting Stage 7 SC-islets.
graveyard_entries.replacement_solution: Use B2M::HLA-E*01:03-VMAPRTLVL-P2A-CD47 in Universal Chassis A (using HLA-A2 leader VMAPRTLVL), or in Plan B / Design B-prime select functional SP-1C leader HLA-C superdonor alleles (C1: HLA-C*01:02 or C*03:04; C2: HLA-C*04:01 or C*06:02 rather than non-functional SP-3C HLA-C*07:02) and/or co-express exogenous HLA-E SCT + CD47-IgV-GPI at AAVS1 Locus 4 (Design B-prime; Q2-P1..P3).

trigger_pattern.condition: Simultaneous base/prime edits B >= 2 multiplexed with Cas9/Cas12a DSBs

graveyard_entries.proposed_idea: Treat multiplex Adenine/Cytosine Base Editing (ABE/CBE) and Prime Editing across 4-6 loci simultaneously as 'zero-risk, zero-DSB' modifications on top of 5 Cas9/Cas12a knockouts.
graveyard_entries.why_it_fails: Wu et al. 2024 (Genome Biology, PMID:39529170, PMC11552398) experimentally evaluated single-locus editing across Cas9, adenine base editing (ABE), and cytosine base editing (CBE) in mouse embryos and primary T cells and attributed elevated structural variants under ABE to deaminase activity (while finding lower structural variation for CBE than Cas9; prime editing [PE] was not an experimental comparator in Wu et al. 2024 and represents an engineering nickase/reverse-transcriptase extrapolation); extrapolating Cas9n D10A single-strand nicks and deaminase bystander edits across multiplex loci alongside Cas9/Cas12a nucleases in SC-islets is an engineering precaution against compounded clonal QC attrition and translocation/deletion risk (whereas Universal Chassis A's K=4, B=0 design uses a 2-pass orthogonal nuclease workflow—Pass 1 AsCas12a Ultra at B2M + CIITA, Pass 2 HiFi-SpCas9 R691A at CXCL10 + AAVS1—with mandatory CAST-seq and Bionano optical genome mapping release gates).
graveyard_entries.cheapest_falsification_assay: Optical genome mapping (Bionano) + 30x whole-genome sequencing + CAST-seq translocation quantification in post-edited iPSC master bank clones.
graveyard_entries.replacement_solution: Keep Universal Chassis A at B=0 base edits (K=4 chromosomal loci total); penalize each simultaneous base edit by 0.965^B in the evaluator.

trigger_pattern.condition: Aggressive pan-autoantigen/GWAS editing stack combining biallelic G6PC2/SLC30A8 knockouts with multiplex coding edits at high-pLI GAD2 (pLI=1.000) or knockout of high-pLI beta-cell survival brakes (PTPN2 pLI=0.990, TNFAIP3 pLI=1.000)

graveyard_entries.proposed_idea: Knock out T1D GWAS candidate genes PTPN2 or TNFAIP3 (A20) to prevent autoimmune recognition, or apply aggressive multiplex knockouts/coding disruptions across GAD2 (GAD65, pLI=1.000) alongside biallelic G6PC2-/- and SLC30A8-/- in a 6-gene pan-autoantigen stack.
graveyard_entries.why_it_fails: gnomAD v4 human constraint demonstrates strong population-level loss-of-function constraint for PTPN2 (pLI=0.990), TNFAIP3 (pLI=1.000), and GAD2 (pLI=1.000). PTPN2 and TNFAIP3 (A20) are essential anti-apoptotic brakes whose loss sensitizes beta-cells to cytokine death and graft hyperinflammation (Moore et al. 2009 PMID:19336676 for PTPN2; Grey et al. 1999 PMID:10523611 and Zammit et al. 2019 PMID:31581152 for TNFAIP3/A20), while GAD2 synthesizes intra-islet GABA required for paracrine regulation of islet hormone secretion and alpha-cell glucagon suppression (Rorsman et al. 1989 Nature PMID:2550826; Menegaz et al. 2019 Nature Metabolism PMID:32432213), so unvalidated coding disruption or bystander indels at GAD2 in a 6-locus multiplex edit stack risks paracrine dysregulation. More broadly across the 112 germline-associated T1D genetic regions triaged in IIP-0018, beta-cell knockout is likewise excluded for nearest-gene mitophagy regulator CLEC16A at 16p13 (Soleimanpour et al. 2014 PMID:24949970, where intronic rs12708716 loops instead to pro-inflammatory DEXI; Dos Santos et al. 2019 PMID:30478640), protective causal-sign survival and lineage brakes BACH2 (Marroquí et al. 2014 PMID:24608439), CTSH (Fløyel et al. 2014 PMID:24982147), SOCS1, GLIS3, DLK1, and INS, and necroptosis-restraining adaptors CASP8 and FADD whose deletion unleashes RIPK3 lytic necroptosis (Kaiser et al. 2011 PMID:21368762). Additional off-grid lineage and constraint guardrails (IIP-0022; DEC-101): TNFRSF1A exhibits strong human LoF constraint (gnomAD v4 pLI = 0.9999, o/e = 0.216, upper bound = 0.3775; cautioning against unvalidated knockout while noting population LoF constraint does not by itself prove differentiated-cell knockdown lethality), whereas mouse islet and human EndoC-betaH1 studies report resistance of beta cells to canonical TNF/BV6/zVAD RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis (Takiishi et al. 2023 PMID:36707047, including MLKL phosphorylation without ensuing death; Veli et al. 2024 PMID:39004142; Zhao et al. 2015 PMID:25301392) in contrast to vascular endothelial cells—requiring separate human SC-beta vs PLVAP+ iEC causal viability and rescue testing rather than assuming universal beta-cell protection from RIPK3 knockdown (and noting ICAM1/CD58 adhesion-knockout immune-evasion studies in Saha et al. 2025 PMID:40796566 and Hammer et al. 2024 PMID:38981470 require product-specific efferocytosis verification rather than representing demonstrated SC-islet failures).
graveyard_entries.cheapest_falsification_assay: Cytokine cocktail (IFN-gamma + IL-1beta + TNF-alpha) apoptosis assay and alpha-cell glucagon suppression perifusion assay.
graveyard_entries.replacement_solution: Never knock out PTPN2, TNFAIP3, or GAD2; use TYK2-/- (pLI=2.8e-7) or inducible TNFAIP3/SERPINB9 gain-of-function instead.

trigger_pattern.condition: Constitutive viral overexpression of secreted IL-10 in allogeneic islets without physiological multi-cytokine co-regulation

graveyard_entries.proposed_idea: Constitutively overexpress viral or recombinant IL-10 alone in allogeneic islets to locally suppress host T-cells.
graveyard_entries.why_it_fails: Conservative project exclusion policy under mechanistic uncertainty: unbuffered constitutive viral IL-10 overexpression alone is excluded from candidate stacks in favor of contact-dependent checkpoints (PD-L1) and intracellular granzyme B inhibition (SERPINB9), whereas physiological or multi-cytokine tolerogenic combinations (such as Gerace et al. 2023 PMID:36599351 combining IL-10 + TGF-beta + IL-2 mutein) are evaluated separately. Note on citation provenance: Polukort et al. 2016 (PMID:27183617) is a mucosal food-allergy mast-cell expansion study (not an islet transplantation experiment) and is retained strictly as a non-islet mechanistic caution on pleiotropic IL-10 mast-cell signaling rather than direct islet-graft counter-evidence.
graveyard_entries.cheapest_falsification_assay: In vivo allogeneic graft histology quantifying mast-cell/granulocyte infiltrate.
graveyard_entries.replacement_solution: Use cell-surface contact checkpoints (PD-L1) + intracellular granzyme blockade (SERPINB9) driven by endogenous inflammation-inducible promoters (CXCL10 locus).

trigger_pattern.condition: Single-copy endogenous B2M promoter driving bicistronic HLA-E-trimer-P2A-CD47 without verified Hour-0 resting surface molecule/cell threshold across beta, alpha, delta, and iEC lineages

graveyard_entries.proposed_idea: Assume that knocking HLA-E-trimer-P2A-CD47 into endogenous B2M exon 1 automatically achieves the ~180,000-220,000 CD47 molecules/cell threshold achieved by lentiviral CAG/EF1a overexpression in Hu et al. 2024 (PMID:37156915).
graveyard_entries.why_it_fails: Mature resting human Stage 7 beta-cells have low basal B2M/MHC-I transcription in the absence of IFN-alpha/gamma, and P2A ribosomal skipping between a type-I single-chain HLA-E trimer and CD47 yields <1:1 downstream surface trafficking and leaves a C-terminal P2A peptide scar on the upstream protein (note: Deuse et al. 2019 PMID:30778232 and Han et al. 2019 PMID:31040209 used strong constitutive CAG/EF1a promoters (while Colli et al. 2020 PMID:32444635 documented low basal beta-cell MHC-I prior to IFN-alpha) rather than endogenous B2M transcription, so resting B2M-driven surface density is an unvalidated precautionary stoichiometry risk). Furthermore, selecting the HLA-A*02:01 leader peptide VMAPRTLVL to avoid activating CD94/NKG2C+ adaptive NK cells replaces the high-affinity HLA-G leader VMAPRTLFL (Kaiser et al. 2008 PMID:18448674 Table 1: WT CD94/NKG2A + VMAPRTLFL K_D = 0.8 +/- 0.055 uM, WT CD94/NKG2C + VMAPRTLFL K_D = 5.2 +/- 0.2 uM, selectivity ratio 6.50x, engineered mutant NKG2C[165-168SIIS] + VMAPRTLFL K_D = 0.9 +/- 0.1 uM; Vales-Gomez et al. 1999 PMID:10428963 Table I: CD94/NKG2A K_D = 2.33 uM for VMAPRTLFL vs CD94/NKG2C K_D = 10.77 uM [selectivity ratio 10.77 / 2.33 = 4.622-fold], CD94/NKG2A K_D = 7.35 uM for HLA-Cw*0302 VMAPRTLIL [whereas HLA-Cw*0402 VMEPRTLIL has K_D >= 75.30 uM], and 11.23 uM for HLA-B*0702 VMAPRTVLL; Lin et al. 2023 Nature Immunology PMID:37264229 Supp. Table 1 soluble HLA-E*01:03 refolded monomer 3D SPR: VMAPRTLVL CD94/NKG2A K_D = 2.10 uM vs CD94/NKG2C K_D = 6.52 uM [ratio 3.1048x < 4.0], VMAPRTLIL 1.33 vs 4.35 uM [ratio 3.2707x < 4.0], and VMAPRTLLL 1.70 vs 4.97 uM [ratio 2.9235x < 4.0]; whereas exact covalently tethered single-chain trimer affinity and selectivity are unmeasured parameters requiring Stage-0 Gate 0A SPR verification), increasing the surface HLA-E molecule/cell threshold required to saturate NKG2A. If resting Hour-0 CD47 and HLA-E surface density on beta-cells or co-transplanted iEC endothelium sits below the host SIRPa/NKG2A inhibitory threshold, innate NK cells and macrophages clear the graft during the first 0-72h before T-cell IFN-gamma ever arrives to upregulate the B2M promoter.
graveyard_entries.cheapest_falsification_assay: QuantiBRITE calibrated flow cytometry measuring absolute surface HLA-E and CD47 molecules/cell on resting (unstimulated) vs +IFN-gamma Stage 7 beta, alpha, delta, and iEC cells, paired with Hour-0 primary human NK and macrophage killing assays across SIRPa V1/V2 and CMV+/NKG2C+ donors.
graveyard_entries.replacement_solution: Pre-specify Decision Experiment #1: if resting endogenous B2M-driven CD47/HLA-E density is below the inhibitory threshold in any lineage (especially iEC endothelium), supplement with a basal housekeeping enhancer floor (e.g., native human EEF1A1-core [230 bp, 19 CpGs, 60.0% GC] + intron or GAPDH/AAVS1 bicistronic co-expression) before in vivo translation.
graveyard_entries.evaluator_disposition_rule: Applies -0.20 logit discount in Gate 3 + requires Decision Experiment #1 QuantiBRITE gate
graveyard_entries.Evaluator_Disposition_Rule: WARN (non-blocking precautionary gate): does NOT set is_feasible_candidate = false; instead triggers Decision Experiment #1 (Hour-0 QuantiBRITE surface stoichiometry gate across beta, alpha, delta, and iEC lineages) and applies a -0.20 logit stoichiometry penalty on Gate 3 unless paired with a housekeeping promoter or verified enhancer floor.

trigger_pattern.condition: Applies to the listed donor MHC-null modules regardless of INS leader/DRiP edits; those edits do not eliminate other host-APC-presented autoantigens or alloantigens.

graveyard_entries.proposed_idea: Assume that because B2M-/- + CIITA-/- eliminates donor surface MHC-I and MHC-II, pre-existing T1D memory CD4+ T-cells, B-cells, and autoantibodies (IAA, GADA, ZnT8A, IA-2A) are completely neutralized.
graveyard_entries.why_it_fails: Donor MHC deletion eliminates only direct T-cell presentation on donor classical HLA-A/B/C and HLA-II. A curative ~0.8B cell graft continuously secretes insulin/C-peptide/IAPP and sheds necrotic cellular debris (GAD65, ZnT8, IA-2, minor histocompatibility antigens, plus synthetic HLA-E linker, P2A scar, and iCasp9-FKBP fusion peptides) during the 0-72h post-implantation window. Recipient conventional dendritic cells (APCs) phagocytose these shed antigens and present them via the canonical indirect pathway on host HLA-DQ2/DQ8 (MHC-II) and cross-present them on host MHC-I to reactivate memory CD4+ and CD8+ T-cells and B-cells; in addition, where residual donor pMHC is present (such as engineered HLA-E single-chain trimers or retained HLA-C in Chassis B), donor extracellular vesicles can cross-dress recipient APC membranes via the semi-direct pathway (Marino et al. 2016 PMID:27942611), driving opsonizing antibodies, complement, and TCR-independent macrophage TNF-alpha/IL-1beta/NO/ROS and FasL/perforin bystander destruction of adjacent MHC-null beta-cells (Demine et al. 2020 PMID:31900242 characterizes beta-cell cytokine/chemokine stress responses, and Hu et al. 2024 PMID:37156915 establishes direct B2M-/- CIITA-/- + CD47 survival, while indirect host-APC presentation and residual donor-vesicle semi-direct cross-dressing remain unmeasured long-term residual hazards). Off-grid PVR/CD155 Ala67Thr (rs1058402) MHC-context & minor-histocompatibility guardrail (IIP-0022; DEC-101): while CD155 Ala67Thr strengthens bivalent CD155-Fc binding to immobilized TIGIT and CD226 (KD ratio 0.271 -> 0.804; Matsuo et al. 2022 PMID:35947095; monovalent WT SPR CD226 530 nM vs TIGIT 1,150 nM vs CD96 3,700 nM in Diong et al. 2023 PMID:37675979) and reduced primary human NK lysis to 0.34/0.41/0.41 of parental on MHC-I-intact HLA-A2+ SC-beta cells (1.062x staining AUC fold ratio; Brown et al. 2025 PMID:41202120), in B2M-/- (MHC-I-null) hPSC/iBeta derivatives lacking classical KIR ligands endogenous CD155 drives activating DNAM-1/CD226 NK killing (82.1% -> 30.2% with anti-CD155 blockade on B2M-/- iPSCs, 50.9% on CD155-/- and 34.6% on CD155/B7-H3-/- iBeta; Chimienti et al. 2022 PMID:36170817), and Thr67 (gnomAD v4 NFE AF = 4.52%, global AF = 5.90%; HWE ~91.16% NFE and ~88.55% global Ala67/Ala67) creates 38 non-canonical 8-11mer windows and overflows single-AAV6 Locus-1 packaging (5,581-5,750 bp > 4,700 bp), making matched B2M-/- TIGIT-low/CD226-high NK testing mandatory for possible synaptic sign inversion before any PVR engineering.
graveyard_entries.cheapest_falsification_assay: Indirect-pathway co-culture assay: HLA-DQ2/DQ8+ T1D patient monocyte-derived dendritic cells pulsed with necrotic/secretome supernatant from B2M-/- CIITA-/- SC-islets + autologous CD4+ T-cells + autologous macrophages co-cultured with live MHC-null SC-islets.
graveyard_entries.replacement_solution: Explicitly cap Gate 2B scores for MHC-null designs with an unmeasured indirect-presentation residual hazard term, minimize Hour-0 necrotic debris (<120 um clusters + pre-vascularized niche), and evaluate whether epitope-level stealth or transient peri-transplant innate/APC blockade is required.
graveyard_entries.evaluator_disposition_rule: Applies -0.25 logit discount in Gate 2B + requires Decision Experiment #2 indirect APC / SA-FasL gate
graveyard_entries.Evaluator_Disposition_Rule: WARN (non-blocking mechanistic precaution): retains the existing -0.25 Gate 2B logit discount for listed MHC-null modules, including INS-edited variants. No hard calibrated probability ceiling is implemented or claimed.

off_grid_molecular_dead_end_guardrails.schema_role: Non-grid Stage-0 molecular, bioconjugation, oxygen-transport, and statistical/epigenetic provenance guardrails (preserving exact 10 grid-firing graveyard_entries for CHK-05 while indexing all shipped IIP-0017..IIP-0026 Stage-0 dead ends and context-dependent traps)

guardrails.summary: CD155 Ala67Thr (rs1058402) reduced primary NK lysis (0.34/0.41/0.41) on HLA-A2+ MHC-I-intact SC-beta cells (PMID:41202120) and improved bivalent CD155-Fc TIGIT/CD226 binding ratio (0.271 -> 0.804, PMID:35947095; monovalent SPR in PMID:37675979), so it is NOT an established universal dead end; however, in B2M-/- iPSC/iBeta targets CD155 mediates activating CD226 lysis (PMID:36170817), Thr67 introduces 38 variant 8-11mers (~88.55% global / ~91.16% NFE HWE Ala/Ala), and full-length PVR overflows Locus-1 AAV6 (5,581-5,750 bp > 4,700 bp). Requires direct sorted TIGIT-low/CD226-high NKG2A- KIR+ NK testing on B2M-/- SC-islets.
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Sorted TIGIT-low/CD226-high NKG2A- KIR+ primary human NK killing assay on matched B2M-/- SC-islets (upper95 <= 8.0% required).

guardrails.summary: Mouse islet and human EndoC-betaH1 models resist canonical RIPK1/RIPK3/MLKL necroptosis (PMID:36707047, PMID:39004142, PMID:25301392), including pMLKL phosphorylation without death, whereas vascular endothelial cells can undergo necroptosis and TNFRSF1A (gnomAD v4 pLI=0.9999) attenuates TNF-alpha NF-kB promoter drive and exceeds 4,700 bp on bGHpA L3-BF-B (4,810 bp). Requires lineage-gated C-peptide+ SC-beta vs CDH5+ PLVAP+ iEC time-resolved viability and orthogonal rescue alongside pMLKL/Cleaved Caspase-3.
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Lineage-separated C-peptide+ SC-beta vs CDH5+ PLVAP+ iEC time-resolved viability and Nec-1s/GSK'872 rescue assay alongside pMLKL and cleaved caspase-3.

guardrails.summary: Installing protective TYK2 p.Pro1104Ala (rs34536443; PMID:27807284) on HLA-C-retaining Design B2 converts internal SPPTKFLEL into SAPTKFLEL with a preferred P2-Ala HLA-C anchor (28.59-65.94 nM across HLA-C*12:03, C*16:01, and C*03:04; PMID:25311805, PMID:32711842, PMID:37207206) foreign to >90% WT G/G recipients, while porcine GSG-P2A scars lack human T-cell data (0 P2A records vs 12 T2A records in IEDB; PMID:23698740). Enforces fail-closed G/G, G/C, and C/C CD8+ priming and HLA-C immunopeptidomics holds.
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: HLA-C allele-matched immunopeptidomics LC-MS/MS for SAPTKFLEL paired with recipient-genotype-stratified (TYK2 G/G, G/C, C/C) autologous CD8+ T-cell priming on SC-islets and iECs.

guardrails.summary: Secreted soluble endothelial IL1R2 alone cannot outcompete membrane IL1R1 + cis IL1RAcP ternary assembly on adjacent beta cells without co-secreted soluble sIL1RAcP (PMID:22426547, PMID:20802483, PMID:12530978), and knocking out nearest-gene T1D GWAS mitophagy regulator CLEC16A at 16p13 (where risk SNPs loop to DEXI; PMID:24949970, PMID:30478640) or necroptosis brakes CASP8/FADD (PMID:21368762) impairs beta-cell survival.
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Isogenic SC-islet IL-1beta + FasL challenge comparing cell-intrinsic Multi-miR(IL1R1 + FAS) against trans-conditioned soluble IL1R2 supernatant without sIL1RAcP.

guardrails.summary: Commercial bovine (UniProt P00432; 50.58% foreign 8-11mers) or fungal Aspergillus niger (P55303; 99.93% foreign 8-11mers) catalase introduces foreign xeno-antigens into a drug-free graft, uncoated edge-touching CaO2 microbeads generate 6.88-19.49 uM local H2O2 plumes against catalase-poor beta cells (PMID:22371586, PMID:8720919, PMID:27729543), and unhydrolyzed thiosuccinimide maleimide linkers undergo retro-Michael deconjugation shedding soluble bioactive FasL (PMID:25194818, PMID:19276268) alongside pre-existing human anti-PEG and secondary anti-streptavidin humoral responses (PMID:27804292, PMID:29466233).
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Gate P05 UniProt P04040 recombinant human catalase peptide/ELISA verification, 20 um barrier-film 24h burst H2O2 assay (<= 2.5 uM), >= 98% DPR-maleimide LC-MS hydrolysis, and 72h primary human hepatocyte ALT/LDH/Caspase-3/7 leachate safety.

guardrails.summary: In a closed 10 mL avascular slab at 50,000 IEQ/mL, standalone 5 g/L M101 extracellular hemoglobin holds 2.17 umol O2 (vs 5,490.6 umol from 791.5 mg CaO2) and releases only 0.19-0.28 umol above 15 mmHg (< 9 seconds of 72h demand; PMID:16897713, PMID:37318185), unencapsulated K_ATP/Ca2+ channel blockers wash out of 140-350 um hydrogels in 7-177 seconds while risking alpha-cell glucagon suppression (PMID:23935835, PMID:17503968), and unwashed or 100 uM racemic Nec-1 pre-conditioning carries off-target ferroptotic/IDO1/NQO1 confounding (PMID:41951603, PMID:34252539).
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Closed-chamber respirometry depletion timing, 120h simultaneous assembled-organoid OCR coupon (upper95 <= 0.80), and washed cell-pellet LC-MS <= LOQ + >= 90% NQO1 activity.

guardrails.summary: Using Cas9 double-strand breaks with large bacterial plasmids for >10 kb multigenic knock-in drives NHEJ vector-backbone capture, concatemers, and p53 selection (PMID:31570731, PMID:36008610), standard attB-in-genome Bxb1 polarity underperforms eePASSIGE 73-bp attP-in-genome + backbone-free attB-minicircle integration (PMID:38858586, PMID:39179886, PMID:42749803), TadCBEd carries residual A>G bystander activity requiring full haplotype NGS (PMID:36357719), and rodent A1/A3 adenosine receptor assumptions fail to reflect human beta-cell ADORA1 GSIS tonus vs alpha-cell/vascular ADORA2A stimulation (PMID:42660457, PMID:38879678).
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Stage-0 Y-01..Y-04 gates: KanR/ori backbone VAF = 0, ddPCR copy number = 2.00 +/- 0.10, full C>T + A>G + indel haplotype NGS, human islet + DPCPX ADORA1 perifusion (SI >= 3.0), and N_eff >= 299,573,228 AP1903 clonogenic kill.

guardrails.summary: Carrying LOT_SCOPE or ASSEMBLED_DEVICE_LOT_SCOPE measurements forward across distinct differentiation lots or device assemblies lets an untested Stage-7 lot inherit prior clonal/functional clearance despite differentiation-emergent 1q32.1 MDM4 or 20q11.21 BCL2L1 subclonal takeover (PMID:38964325, PMID:24286026) and dynamic GSIS maturation drift (PMID:35241836). Likewise, omitting integer (k, n) denominators on zero-event rare-event gates, dropping k == 0 observed-zero hard vetoes, substituting floor(n * eta) or naive floor(n * eta / DEFF) on clustered rare events (where ICC = 0 can still carry P(K = 0) = 14.14% > 5.0%), omitting Gate P05 P04040 mass-coupled endotoxin or IgG-depleted CD16+ ADCC controls (PMID:27787618, PMID:35743287), or resetting safety stops without same-scope independent-unit washout QP verification (PMID:22047558) are permanently barred.
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Differential Stage-0 replay across 4/5/7-key MCB_SCOPE, LOT_SCOPE, and ASSEMBLED_DEVICE_LOT_SCOPE tuples with strict integer (k, n), k == 0 observed-zero vetoes, exact (1 - 0.05**(1/n)) / eta bounds, and latched adverse stop-reset audits.

guardrails.summary: Comparing engineered construct arms across unblocked hPSC donor backgrounds confounds construct attribution with 5-46% inter-donor iPSC trait variance (44.35% false >25% shifts at sigma_donor = 0.20 vs 0.13% under Donor-1 paired lot blocking; PMID:28489815), while asymptotic z = 1.644854 inflates 6-lot Type-I error to 8.05% (12.09% at 3 lots) and unbalanced 6 + 3 Welch TOST drops +15%-drift equivalence power to 41.38% vs 97.00% on balanced 6 + 6 lots. Unscreened hPSC banks and Stage-7 lots also carry persistent germline imprinting loss at IC1, IC2/KvDMR1, and primary IG-DMR vs secondary somatic MEG3-DMR (PMID:20585555, PMID:24402520), irreversible 46,XX XCI erosion (PMID:22560080, PMID:27989715), and clonal chrM heteroplasmy expansion during reprogramming/culture (PMID:27436875, PMID:27151456).
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Screen >= 2 unrelated ABO O/O hPSC seed lines (pi_hat < 0.05) with phased 5mC IC1/IC2/IG-DMR panels, >= 300-nucleus 46,XX XIST + promoter-CpG/X-RNA assays, diploid MDM4/20q11.21 ddPCR + >= 299-cell DNA-FISH, and >= 1,000x NUMT-filtered chrM sequencing, followed by m >= 6 Donor-1 paired differentiation blocks and 6 + 6 unpooled Welch 90% TOST.

guardrails.summary: Gating 3D encapsulated islet oxygen competence on spatial-mean harmonic-face or shell-mean pO2 masks focal boundary hypoxia below the 15.0 mmHg GSIS floor (ordered 100-um clusters at 1,500 IEQ/cm^2 report 17.0804 mmHg spatial mean while worst-face pO2 drops to 12.6776-13.0542 mmHg no-film and 12.6447-12.8978 mmHg with 20-um barrier films across 40x40x70, 60x60x105, and 80x80x140 meshes, and Design Z 140-um Zero-CaO2 at 30 mmHg reports 16.1510 mmHg shell mean while worst-face pO2 is 14.2854 mmHg; PMID:21788575, PMID:21693022, PMID:38993891, PMID:37476069). Likewise, shrinking cluster diameter from 100 um to 80 um at unchanged 198.76/213.58 um pitch halves single-pouch functional beta-cell dose by 48.8% (768 vs 1,500 IEQ/cm^2; 3.296M vs 1.688M clusters at 500,000 IEQ; PMID:35241836), and sizing Gate P05 human catalase (UniProt P04040) from Day-7 70% retention (~105,429 IU post-cure) while allowing 50% Day-14 retention drops 336-h activity to 52,714 IU < 73,800 IU or breaches the 158,300 U pre-cure ceiling unless cure yield exceeds 93.24% (whereas 65% cure yield requires >= 71.724% Day-14 retention; PMID:35743287, PMID:27729543).
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Multi-mesh 3D finite-volume unrounded dual-band worst-face oxygen verification across nx in {40, 60, 80} paired with dose-matched 142.22 um square / 152.83 um hex 80-um Contrast B1 coupons and same-lot two-timepoint (Day-7 L95_t >= 70.0% and 336-h L95_t >= 73,800 IU) human P04040 catalase mass/endotoxin/z=70.0 um H2O2 verification.

guardrails.summary: Substituting fixed dbSnp155 screening priors across 56 target-window loci misses three PASS gnomAD v4.1 WGS variants >= 0.1% in AFR/SAS/ASJ (rs142469968 CIITA 0.212% AFR, rs946359931 AAVS1 0.290% SAS with exome absent, and rs373614901 TYK2 0.115% ASJ; PMID:36522432), while GRCh38-only HLA-A/B guide screening admits 6/17 HLA-A and 4/10 HLA-B guides scoring 0.0500-1.0000 across 17 non-reference HLA-C Exon 2-3 records (PMID:26780180) and DT9 flow without a matched HLA-E-only specificity control confounds retained HLA-C with HLA-E cross-reactivity (PMID:21248048). Likewise, averaging post-edit BAF across loci hides discordant clonal LOH/isodisomy (PMID:18796520, PMID:32460021, PMID:30850590), treating lookup CFD = 0.000000 on Mode-B ACC shields as proof against HiFi-SpCas9 R691A cleavage (PMID:23873081), pooling ungated TYK2 PE4max MLH1dn without distinct FAIL_MSI_DETECTED + piecewise repeat-indel caps (PMID:34653350, PMID:35140211), or claiming 95% Design Y ddPCR LoD at 30,000 GE (57.68% Poisson power vs >= 63,000 single-unit 95.02% / >= 90,000 pooled 99.38%; PMID:38858586) are permanently barred.
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Phased >= 30x donor WGS across all target windows + HLA-A/B/C/E, separated chr6p21.3 HLA-A/B passes with DT9 + 3D12 flow paired with matched HLA-E-only controls (>= 2.0x delta), per-locus >= 50-SNP segmented BAF (<= 0.05 shift) + reciprocal-mosaic SV checks, 48-clone PE2max vs PE4max pentaplex MSI + piecewise WGS repeat-indel counting, and >= 63,000/90,000 GE Design Y ddPCR + UDiTaS capture.

guardrails.summary: Knocking protective transgenes (CD47-IgV-GPI, SERPINB9, or PD-L1) into the endogenous chr11p15.5 INS 3'-UTR behind a 2,638-nt EIF4G2 (DAP5) non-canonical translation element (OQ-011) leaves the 48.58% non-beta graft compartment (alpha, delta, iEC, iPericyte; 4.535e8 of 9.335e8 cells) with zero INS-driven protection (PMID:27667365, PMID:35241836; GY-001, GY-002), expands the compact 73-nt human INS 3'-UTR 37.14-fold to 2,711 nt where UPF1 length-dependent decay and 8/15 guide cuts across PTBP1 insPRS (nt 18..41) threaten insulin mRNA stability (PMID:11696543, PMID:15228089, PMID:15039777, PMID:21029861), introduces a targeted Cas9 DSB 1,183 bp from imprinted IGF2 and 155,227 bp from H19 at 11p15.5 (PMID:18796520, PMID:30010673, PMID:34050011), and relies on GUG + uATG cap-independent initiation (~5-15% single-step; PMID:10611228, PMID:11943866, PMID:26816383) confounded in EIF4G1 reporter literature by cryptic Pol II promoters (PMID:12370285, PMID:22618870). Retires INS 3'-UTR protective knock-ins in favor of pan-lineage chr19 AAVS1 divergent 2A-free CD47-IgV-GPI + iCasp9 (c5/c6) and chr4 CXCL10 SERPINB9 + PD-L1 (c1..c3), while keeping scored B1's separate unresolved INS leader/DRiP epitope base-edit record distinct.
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Keep chr11 INS wild-type (verified by 90% TOST insulin mRNA/secretion equivalence and bank/lot 11p15.5 IC1/IC2 + per-locus segmented BAF surveillance) and qualify pan-lineage AAVS1 divergent CD47-IgV-GPI + iCasp9 (c5 4,172 bp / c6 4,394 bp) plus CXCL10 SERPINB9 + PD-L1 (c1..c3) across endocrine and vascular lineages.

guardrails.summary: Certifying longitudinal islet proteostasis from an optional standalone 72-h A11 dot-blot fails because A11 binds generic non-IAPP soluble oligomers (PMID:12702875) while IAPP amyloid accumulates over 4-24 weeks in human SC-islet/islet grafts and clinical betaAir explants (PMID:38603470, PMID:20160085, PMID:29288549). Clearing humoral safety on C5b-9 complement resistance alone omits FcgammaRIIIA (CD16+) cellular antibody killing (requiring both intact-serum total killing and paired IgG-attributable ADCC U95_t <= 5.0%; PMID:27787618, PMID:23274902, PMID:24804568) and borrowing active Arm-3 evidence or retained-active SA-FHL-1 into post-depletion Arm 2 masks rebound vulnerability. Lowering DEC-084 70:20:10 / 70:25:5 loading without measured starting per-beta potency (0.95x fails OCR > 0.90; 0.90x or P_b <= 34 mmHg fails 15.0 mmHg worst-face oxygen) or empirical glucagon gates (4/7 and 5/7 reference alpha-cell counts; PMID:39169271), and deploying synthetic heterologous SFTPB/INS/IAPP/B2M-leader BRICHOS fusions (34 unmatched 8-11-mer and 14 15-mer Swiss-Prot windows across both Bri2[90-263] PMID:41212211 and Bri2[90-236] PMID:29507232 comparators; Bri23 occupancy caveat PMID:38864729) or oversized single-AAV6 Locus 3 (5,181+ bp) / Locus 4 (4,876 bp) ITM2B knock-ins are permanently barred, holding native RefSeq NM_021999.5 ITM2B (801-nt CDS 156..956 SHA-256 6fc8d3d7..., 0 unmatched windows) at 0% active weight.
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Registry-bound arm-separated Gate 0d + paired intact-and-IgG-depleted CD16+ ADCC (U95_t <= 5.0%), measured-potency n = 8 DEC-084 confirmation blocks (U95_t OCR <= 0.90, L95_t C-peptide & glucagon AUC >= 0.85, Readout 2), and visit/lot/sister-bound 72-h / Day-28 / Day-84 dual-modality IAPP oligomer ELISA + anti-IAPP colocalized fibril area alongside viable beta mass across >= 6 distinct lots.

guardrails.summary: Extending Stage 6-7 maturation with terminal ALK5i II / TGFb-inhibitor continuation suppresses dynamic GSIS peak ~8-9-fold (Velazco-Cruz et al. 2019 PMID:30661993 Fig. 5F), whereas Balboa et al. 2022 (PMID:35241836) and protocol companion Barsby et al. 2022 (PMID:36136756) omit ALK5i while retaining 10 nM T3 + 1 mM NAC + 0.5 uM ZM447439; co-assembling mitotic iEC/pericyte microvessels without verified pre-co-assembly ZM447439 washout (LC-MS/MS <= LLOQ <= 0.005 uM across >= 3 washes with 80-120% spike recovery plus endothelial vascular function verification) is barred. Qualifying Rule S8 extended maturation on single-pulse GSIS alone misses late-culture second-pulse depletion (-32.8% to -37.7% in Veres et al. 2019 PMID:31068696 Ext. Data Fig. 2) and > 138.3 IU mature-insulin inventory escalations, whereas universal cross-protocol High2/High1 floors (such as >= 0.80, rejecting 5/7 primary adult human static donor controls in PMID:31068696) or conflated integrated Low1/High1 <= 0.15 gates are equally barred. Reporting post-sort functional gains without common-denominator sorting+reaggregation recovery eta_sort (or applying per-cell eta_sort to per-DNA measurements), clearing tiny near-zero increments on ratio alone without unit-bound and contemporaneous adult-islet reference floors, unadjusted multi-window selection without Bonferroni or a disjoint pilot, substituting within-recipe age ratios into DEC-084 between-mixture sizing, bypassing live atomic-ledger Gate 0S escalation above 138.3 IU (or granting standalone non-ledger clinical release), and replacing empirical Readout 2 with uncalibrated cross-protocol Mode B ODE parameter inversion are permanently barred (IIP-0029; DEC-108).
guardrails.cheapest_falsification_assay: Locked-timestamp two-clock, two-pulse microfluidic perifusion (+35-min 15-min Low2 -> 20-min High2 extension) across n >= 6 independent differentiation blocks (n >= 8 for registered DEC-084 mixtures) at matched 40 and 100 mmHg with contemporaneous primary adult human islet controls, per-trace fluorescent inert-tracer tau_chamber <= 0.50 min, common-denominator viable recovery eta_sort, analytical LC-MS/MS <= 0.005 uM pre-iEC ZM447439 washout + vascular function verification, mature-insulin-specific acid-ethanol inventory assay, and linked scope-matched atomic-ledger Gate 0S review whenever U95_t > 138.3 IU or max_lot > 138.3 IU.
